body.x: Dell participated in “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Unveiled” held on January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to introduce Alienware monitor of an extraordinary design.

The Alienware monitor was finished with classy and refined touch, and also was equipped with modernly designed Triad lighting which emits beautiful lights so that it surpasses the normal aesthetics. Especially, it features the aspect ratio of 21:9 display made of the Wide Viewing Angle IPS panel which presents superb visual effects in all viewing angles. Therefore, it provides the environment in which the user can be completely immersed in the games.

Moreover, the new hinge-combo design applied to this product enables you to adjust its tilt, swivel, and height so that you can keep the optimum view for your games. And, the lighting system of AlienFX RGB has the dynamic lighting effect of being directly linked to the actions inside the game so that you can get nearer to the world where your game takes place.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
